youtube.title: Why You Can't Quit Things You Already Paid For
youtube.description:
He hated the film and still would not walk out. The reason is the sunk cost fallacy, and it follows you well beyond the cinema.

In three minutes you will see how a spent ticket, a paid course and a prepaid phone plan keep one man in his seat. You will hear what the sunk cost fallacy is, why money already gone should not decide what you do next, and where researchers say the effect is weaker than people think. If you search for a sunk cost fallacy example, this is one you can picture.

00:00 The ticket
00:24 Just leave
00:54 The pull has a name
01:22 The course he paid for
01:56 The unused plan
02:24 Credits

Question for the comments: what are you stuck in, only because you paid for it?

Characters and events are made up for this story. Music credit: none.
